original_test_intent: Verify the owner-defined POWER record population across IB SDR/Sensor List, OOB SDR/Sensor List and BMC Web against the approved PSU, rail, board, processor and device power topology and acceptance rules.
original_method: Enumerate each approved POWER record; bind it to a physical power path; distinguish instantaneous or averaged power, accumulated energy, derived electrical values and power-good/discrete states; retain complete aligned IB/OOB lists and Web rows; compare values, units, thresholds, states and freshness under recorded workload.
manual_activity: The owner defines the POWER population, record semantics, topology and limits and resolves criteria 3–77; an operator records Web and workload context, then the owner decides the verdict.
required_inputs: Exact POWER inclusion list and per-record IDs/types
Per-record units/scaling, measurement interval, thresholds and acceptable states/ranges
Aligned workload, power policy and thermal context
Protected access, full Web evidence and criteria 3–77 decision
safety_requirements: Use read-only collection and protected credentials
Do not alter power policy, PSU state, rails, thresholds or BMC settings
Do not combine watts, accumulated energy and discrete power-good states
Do not use the item title as a sensor or truncated evidence
Stop on alarm, unknown semantics, missing/duplicate/stale record, identity mismatch or channel disagreement
agent_execution_scope: Verify the unique source and collect full read-only IB/OOB inventories
Classify each approved POWER record by semantic type and physical path
Normalize values/states with workload and timing and complete Web parity
Perform no policy/threshold action, population decision, criteria invention or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve POWER inclusion list, physical topology, record semantics and limits
Resolve criteria-number gap and any allowed derived-value relationship
Review per-record evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool is relevant, but `sensor get 'Check POWER'` invents an aggregate record and the head-limited fallback cannot establish the broad population or Web parity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely retain full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, exact-match every approved POWER record, capture all Web rows and compare values or states by semantic type and physical path.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The broad POWER source scope, both IB/OOB lists, Web, SPEC comparison, Config-Check and 3/0-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a per-record matrix containing physical path, measurement/status type, unit, sampling interval, raw/decoded state and timestamp across IB/OOB/Web.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds semantic and topology normalization without changing power state.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A single aggregate reading can hide missing rails and cannot substitute between watts, energy or power-good state.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Values legitimately change with workload and sampling cadence; aligned context and approved tolerances are required.

project_override_considerations: Derived power from voltage/current or energy/interval is acceptable only under explicitly approved formulas, synchronized samples and error tolerances; otherwise retain each source record independently.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and broad-filter/criteria defect record
Versioned POWER inclusion list, topology and semantic rules
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists with timestamps/exits
Per-record physical path, value/unit or raw/decoded state and complete Web rows
Workload/policy/thermal context, missing/extra/duplicate analysis, criteria decision, no-write/no-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: POWER is an undefined broad filter that can combine incompatible measurement and status types, criteria jump from 2 to 78, and DeepSeek substitutes one synthetic item-label query plus truncated output.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Passive inventory is feasible; record membership, semantics, topology and source clarification are supplyable owner inputs.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2034 Wistron-BMC-01053-V002: define the exact POWER record population and PSU/rail/board/processor/device topology, separate instantaneous/average power, energy, derived electrical and power-good/status semantics with units/scaling/limits, and confirm whether Criteria 1, 2, 78 is only misnumbered or Criteria 3–77 are missing.

review_improvement: Expands the POWER population, separates incompatible measurement and status semantics, binds evidence to physical paths and rejects the synthetic aggregate query.
independent_technical_reasoning: A name containing POWER is not a common quantity: some records can report watts, others accumulated energy or a discrete good/fail bit. Comparing those fields as if interchangeable would create false agreement. Acceptance must therefore be per record type and physical path with aligned workload and timing, while the missing criteria are escalated rather than invented.
